vermin.name: Rats

post_combat_effects.description: At the end of the encounter, every PC wounded by a rat must roll a 1-in-6 chance of losing 1 Life to infection.

vermin.notes: HCL+0 (Maximum L4). No Treasure. Goblins, trolls, orcs, lizardmen and ogres eat rats. Count each rat as 1 Food ration for them.

vermin.name: Vampire Bats

combat_modifiers.description: Spellcasting rolls are at -1 due to their distracting shrieking.

vermin.notes: HCL+0 (Maximum L3). No Treasure. Despite the vampire moniker, these creatures are animals, not undead.

vermin.name: Goblin Swarmlings

combat_modifiers.description: Dwarves attack goblin swarmlings at +1 to Attack rolls.

reactions.result: The goblin swarmlings flee if outnumbered.
The goblin swarmlings demand a bribe.

vermin.notes: HCL+1 Vermin (Maximum L4). When rolling for treasure -1. When rolling for Morale -1.

on_hit_effects.description: All living PCs hit by a centipede must Save vs. L2 poison or lose 1 additional Life.

reactions.result: The giant centipedes flee if outnumbered.
The vampire frogs demand a Blood Offering.
The vampire frogs fight to the death!

vermin.name: Skeletal Rats

vulnerabilities.description: Crushing weapons attack Skeletal Rats at +1.
A vial of Holy water automatically kills 2 skeletal rats.

vermin.notes: HCL+2 (Max Level 5). No Treasure. Immune to sleep, disease and poison. Unaffected by ranged weapons.

minions.name: Skeletons/Zombies

vulnerabilities.description: A vial of holy water will automatically destroy 1 skeleton or zombie.
Arrows/crossbow bolts are at -1 vs. skeletons and zombies.

reactions.result: The skeletons/zombies fight to the death!

minions.notes: Roll d6: 1-3 = d6+2 Skeletons, 4-6 = d6 Zombies. HCL+2 Undead Minions. No treasure. Never test Morale. Zombies are max. L6.

minions.name: Goblins
minions.notes: HCL+2 Minions (Max. L6). Treasure -1. Goblins have a 1-in-6 chance of surprising the party. Roll on their Reactions if they do, even if met as Wandering Monsters.

reactions.result: The hobgoblins fight to the death!

minions.name: Orcs

combat_modifiers.description: Orcs fear magic and must roll Morale every turn in which 1+ orcs are defeated by a spell. If the spell reduces their number to 1/2 or less, their Morale roll is at -1.

loot_special.description: They never have magic items in their loot. If you roll one, you find d6xd6gp instead.

reactions.result: The orcs fight to the death!

minions.notes: HCL+3 Minions (max. L10). Elves attack orcs at +1. Orcs fear magic and must roll Morale every turn in which 1+ orcs are defeated by a spell.

minions.name: Trolls

combat_modifiers.description: Halflings add +L to Defense rolls vs. trolls.

regeneration.description: Trolls regenerate unless slain by magic, fire or acid, or unless a PC spends 1 turn to hack their bodies to pieces with a slashing weapon. Otherwise, every slain troll has a 2-in-6 chance of returning to life on its next turn, continuing to fight.

reactions.result: The trolls fight to the death!
reactions.conditions: If there are dwarves in the party, trolls always fight to the death.

minions.notes: HCL+4 Minions (max. L7). Halflings add +L to Defense rolls vs. trolls. If there are dwarves in the party, trolls always fight to the death.

minions.name: Mushroom Men

on_hit_effects.description: Living PCs hit by a mushroom man must Save vs. L3 poison or lose 1 additional Life. Halflings Save at +L. Mushroom PCs are immune.

reactions.result: The mushroom men demand a bribe.

minions.notes: HCL+2 Minions (max. L10). Living PCs hit by a mushroom man must Save vs. L3 poison or lose 1 additional Life.

weird.name: Minotaur

combat_modifiers.description: Due to its charge, the first Defense roll vs. a minotaur's attack is at -1.
Halflings can't use Luck in minotaur encounters.

reactions.result: The minotaur fights to the death!

weird.notes: HCL+4 Weird Monster, Tier+3 Life, 2 attacks. Due to its charge, the first Defense roll vs. a minotaur's attack is at -1. Halflings can't use Luck in minotaur encounters.

weird.name: Iron Eater

on_hit_effects.description: Its attacks inflict no damage but destroy metal items, including magic ones: first armor, then shields, then main weapon, then 3d6gp, in this order. Light armor and shield give their normal Defense bonuses against its attacks. Heavy armor does not, unless it is non-metallic.

reactions.result: The iron eater can be distracted with gold (d6gp, but you can't use Fools' Gold).

weird.notes: HCL+2 Weird Monster, Tier+3 Life, 3 attacks. No treasure. Its attacks inflict no damage but destroy metal items. Light armor and shield give normal Defense bonuses; heavy armor does not unless non-metallic.

weird.name: Chimera

special_attacks.description: Roll a 2-in-6 chance each turn that it will breathe fire instead of performing its 3 attacks. If it does so, all PCs must Save vs. L4 fire or lose 1 Life.

weird.notes: HCL+4 Chaos Weird Monster, Tier+5 Life, 3 attacks. Roll a 2-in-6 chance each turn that it will breathe fire instead of performing its 3 attacks.

weird.name: Catoblepas

encounter_start_effects.description: At the beginning of the encounter, all PCs must Save vs. L4 gaze or lose 1 Life.

weird.notes: HCL+3 Weird Monster, Tier+3 Life. Treasure +1. At the beginning of the encounter, all PCs must Save vs. L4 gaze or lose 1 Life.

weird.name: Giant Spider

on_hit_effects.description: A living PC hit by the giant spider must Save vs. L3 poison or lose 1 Life.

combat_restrictions.description: Because of the spider's web, PCs may not flee until a Fireball is cast (in addition to damaging the spider, it will burn its web) or a torch is spent to destroy it.

weird.notes: HCL+4 Weird Monster, Tier+2 Life, 2 attacks. Treasure: 2 rolls. PCs may not flee until a Fireball is cast or a torch is spent to destroy the web.

weird.name: Invisible Gremlins

event_effects.description: They steal d6+3 items from the PCs. Items protected with gremlin repellant will not be stolen. Items are taken in this order: magic items, scrolls, potions, weapons, gems, gold (10gp at a time). If the gremlins steal ALL the equipment, they will leave a thank you message which counts as 1 Clue. Many game effects offer different levels of protection against gremlins. Discovering them is part of the game!

weird.notes: Gremlins have no stats. They are an event, not a Foe, and cannot be the Final Boss. They steal d6+3 items from the PCs.

boss.name: Mummy

on_kill_effects.description: A PC slain by a mummy becomes a mummy one turn later and attacks the party.

vulnerabilities.description: A mummy is flammable. Fire-based attacks and torches attack them at +2 and a flask of oil adds another +2.

reactions.result: The mummy fights to the death!

boss.notes: HCL+4 Undead Boss, Tier+3 Life, 2 attacks. Treasure +2. Never rolls Morale. Immune to Sleep and poison. A PC slain by a mummy becomes a mummy one turn later. Fire attacks at +2, oil flask adds another +2.

boss.name: Orc Brute

loot_special.description: It never has any magic items in its loot: count them as d6xd6gp instead.

reactions.result: The orc brute demands a bribe.
The orc brute fights to the death!

boss.notes: HCL+4 Boss, Tier+4 Life, 2 attacks. Treasure +1. Elves attack him at +1. It never has any magic items in its loot: count them as d6xd6gp instead.

boss.name: Ogre

reactions.result: The ogre fights to the death!

boss.notes: HCL+4 Boss, Tier+4 Life. Its attacks inflict Tier+1 damage.

boss.name: Medusa

encounter_start_effects.description: At the beginning of the encounter, before ranged attacks, all PCs must Save vs. L4 gaze or be turned to stone. Rogues add +1/2L to the Save. A Blessing restores 1 PC.

reactions.result: The medusa fights to the death!

boss.notes: HCL+3 Boss, Tier+3 Life. Treasure +1. At the beginning of the encounter, before ranged attacks, all PCs must Save vs. L4 gaze or be turned to stone. Rogues add +1/2L to the Save.

boss.name: Chaos Lord

powers.result: Evil eye: all PCs must Save vs. L4 magic or be at -1 on their Defense rolls until he is slain.
Energy drain: PCs hit must Save vs. L4 magic or lose 1 L; a Blessing restores all lost levels.
Hellfire blast: at the beginning of the encounter, all PCs must Save vs. L6 magic or lose 2 Life, clerics Save at +1/2 L.

reactions.result: The chaos lord flees if outnumbered.
The chaos lord fights to the death!

boss.notes: HCL+5 Chaos Boss, Tier+3 Life, 3 attacks. 2 Treasure rolls at +1 and a 2-in-6 chance of 1 Clue. Roll d6 to determine its powers: 1-3 no power, 4 evil eye, 5 energy drain, 6 hellfire blast.

boss.name: Young Dragon

breath_weapon.description: On each of its turns, roll d6. On a 1-2, it breathes fire (all PCs must Save vs. L6 breath or lose 2 Life; all add +1/2L to this Save). On a 3-6, it attacks 2 random targets (1 damage).

reactions.result: The dragon is sleeping. All PCs have +2 to their first Attack roll.
The dragon demands all the party's gp with a minimum of 100gp or 1 magic item.

boss.notes: HCL+5 Boss, Tier+4 Life, 2 attacks. 3 Treasure rolls at +1. Immune to Sleep. Never encountered as a Wandering Monster. On each turn, roll d6: 1-2 breathe fire (Save vs L6 breath or 2 Life), 3-6 attack 2 random targets.

caverns_vermin.name: Echo Bats

special_rules.description: In tiles with the Echo rule, increase their L by 1.

reactions.result: The echo bats ignore the PCs.
The echo bats demand a Blood Offering.

caverns_vermin.notes: HCL+1 Animal Vermin (max. L4). Morale +1, no Treasure. In tiles with the Echo rule, increase their L by 1.

caverns_vermin.name: Mud Centipedes

conditional_behavior.description: They always ignore the PCs unless encountered in a tile with a water pool and the PCs inspect the pool — in that case, they always Fight to protect their eggs.

reactions.result: The mud centipedes ignore the PCs.
The mud centipedes fight to the death to protect their eggs!

caverns_vermin.notes: HCL Animal Vermin (max. L4). Standard Morale, no Treasure. They always ignore the PCs unless encountered in a tile with a water pool and the PCs inspect the pool — in that case, they always Fight to protect their eggs.

caverns_vermin.name: Vengeance Cockroaches

special_rules.description: If some flee, note how many escape. The next time you encounter them during the same adventure, add the number of escaped cockroaches to those encountered.

reactions.result: The vengeance cockroaches demand a bribe.

caverns_vermin.notes: HCL+1 Animal Vermin (max. L3). No Treasure. Immune to Sleep. If some flee, note how many escape. The next time you encounter them during the same adventure, add the number of escaped cockroaches to those encountered.

caverns_vermin.name: Stalactomimics

special_rules.description: These small rock elementals look like stalactites and hide on cave ceilings, plummeting on their victims to impale them with their sharp tips. Each attacks only once, always surprising the PCs.

caverns_vermin.notes: HCL+2 Elemental Vermin, no Treasure. Immune to Sleep and Poison. These small rock elementals look like stalactites and hide on cave ceilings, plummeting on their victims to impale them with their sharp tips. Each attacks only once, always surprising the PCs.

caverns_vermin.name: Screaming Toads

combat_modifiers.description: Their deafening croaking gives -1 to all spellcasting rolls.

encounter_duration_effects.description: If they are not slain within a single turn, roll a 2-in-6 chance that Wandering Monsters arrive at the end of the encounter.

reactions.result: The screaming toads demand a bribe.

caverns_vermin.notes: HCL+3 Animal Vermin, Morale +1, no Treasure. Their deafening croaking gives -1 to all spellcasting rolls. If they are not slain within a single turn, roll a 2-in-6 chance that Wandering Monsters arrive at the end of the encounter.

caverns_vermin.name: Red Cave Spiders

on_damage_effects.arm_effects: Cannot sling a shield or use a ranged or two-handed weapon, but can hold a lantern or a torch.
on_damage_effects.cure: Healing or Blessing removes the paralysis.
on_damage_effects.description: Any living PC taking 2+ damage will have a paralyzed limb (roll d6, 1-3 arm, 4-6 leg).

reactions.result: The red cave spiders fight to the death!

caverns_vermin.notes: HCL+2 Animal Vermin, Morale -1. Immune to Poison. Any living PC taking 2+ damage will have a paralyzed limb (roll d6, 1-3 arm, 4-6 leg). A paralyzed arm cannot sling a shield or use a ranged or two-handed weapon, but can hold a lantern or a torch. A PC with a paralyzed leg cannot flee. A Healing or Blessing removes the paralysis. Ogres, trolls and goblins consider these spiders a delicacy (a spider is 1 Food for them).

caverns_minions.name: Morlocks

combat_modifiers.description: A PC with a lantern, torch or other light source has +2 to Defense rolls against them.

reactions.result: The morlocks demand 15gp or 5 Food rations for the whole group.
The morlocks offer information; count this as the Morlock Spy result on the Caverns Events Table.

caverns_minions.notes: HCL+3 Minions. Morale -1. These pale, cowardly underground humanoids dislike light. A PC with a lantern, torch or other light source has +2 to Defense rolls against them.

caverns_minions.name: Cave Goblins

combat_modifiers.description: Armed with poor quality clubs: PCs in Heavy Armor have an additional +1 to Defense rolls.

reactions.result: The cave goblins demand 5gp per goblin.

caverns_minions.notes: HCL+2 Minions (Max. L5). Morale -1. Treasure -1. 2-in-6 chance of surprise. Armed with poor quality clubs: PCs in Heavy Armor have an additional +1 to Defense rolls.

caverns_minions.name: Cave Skeletons

vulnerabilities.description: A vial of holy water automatically destroys 2 skeletons.

reactions.result: The cave skeletons fight to the death!

caverns_minions.notes: HCL+2 Undead Minions. Never test Morale. Animated bones of miners, covered in mud. Their camouflage gives them a 1-in-6 chance of surprise. Armed with pickaxes. Crushing weapons attack them at +1. A vial of holy water automatically destroys 2 skeletons.

caverns_minions.name: Rat Men of the Deep

opening_ranged_attack.description: Before melee, each rat man performs an HCL+3 ranged attack with its crossbow.

combat_modifiers.description: In melee they use flails: PCs ignore shield Defense bonuses.

reactions.result: The rat men demand 1 Ration, 5gp, or 1 Mushroom per rat man.

caverns_minions.notes: HCL+2 Minions. Before melee, each rat man performs an HCL+3 ranged attack with its crossbow. In melee they use flails: PCs ignore shield Defense bonuses.

caverns_minions.name: Cave Orcs

combat_modifiers.description: Due to their charge, in the first turn of melee PCs have -1 to Defense rolls.
Starting with the second turn, all PCs with Heavy Armor have an additional +1 to Defense rolls due to the poor quality of the orcs' clubs.

reactions.result: The cave orcs offer to buy weapons above Cheap quality at full price; they will not buy if there are dwarves or elves in the party.

caverns_minions.notes: HCL+3 Minions. Due to their charge, in the first turn of melee PCs have -1 to Defense rolls. Starting with the second turn, all PCs with Heavy Armor have an additional +1 to Defense rolls due to the poor quality of the orcs' clubs.

caverns_minions.name: Cavemen

morale_triggers.description: They must roll Morale if one is killed by a fire-based attack. Roll Morale once per encounter, not once per fire-based attack.

reactions.result: The cavemen demand 1 Food Ration per caveman or 1 single gem of any value.

caverns_minions.notes: HCL+2 Minions (Max. L5). No Treasure. Armed with two-handed clubs. They must roll Morale if one is killed by a fire-based attack. Roll Morale once per encounter, not once per fire-based attack.

caverns_weird.name: Drillworm

entry_roll.description: Roll d6: 1-3, it enters from an opening in the tile; 4-6, it appears from underground with a 3-in-6 chance of surprise.

on_defense_roll_1_effects.description: A PC rolling a 1 on Defense loses 1 of the following (choose): shield, weapon, lantern, scroll, potion, all Food. Non-magical items are destroyed. Magic items are retrieved at the end of the combat.

reactions.result: The drillworm fights to the death!

caverns_weird.notes: HCL+4 WM, HCL+3 Life, 1 attack. Treasure: 2 rolls. Immune to Sleep. Roll d6: 1-3 enters from an opening; 4-6 appears from underground (3-in-6 surprise). Its drill inflicts Tier damage. A PC rolling a 1 on Defense loses 1 item (shield, weapon, lantern, scroll, potion, or all Food). Non-magical items are destroyed; magic items are retrieved at the end of combat.

caverns_weird.name: Cavern Wraith

per_turn_effects.description: If at the end of the PCs' turn it was not hit, all PCs automatically lose 1 Life.

reactions.result: The cavern wraith ignores the party.
The cavern wraith demands a Blood Offering.
The cavern wraith fights to the death!

caverns_weird.notes: HCL+3 Undead WM, HCL+2 Life (min. 4). Never rolls Morale. Treasure: 2 rolls. Immune to Sleep and poison. Takes 2 damage from holy water. If at the end of the PCs' turn it was not hit, all PCs automatically lose 1 Life.

caverns_weird.name: Cavern Sludge
caverns_weird.attacks_note: All characters, including animals and hirelings, receive 1 attack per turn.

vulnerabilities.description: If struck by Lightning, it loses 2L in addition to damage.

special_rules.description: If it is brought to L0, it is destroyed.

reactions.result: The cavern sludge fights to the death!

caverns_weird.notes: HCL+2 Slime WM, Tier+3 Life. 1 Attack per PC (all characters, including animals and hirelings, receive 1 attack per turn). Never rolls Morale. Treasure: 1 roll. Immune to Sleep and poison. 4-in-6 chance of surprise. If struck by Lightning, loses 2L in addition to damage. If brought to L0, it is destroyed.

caverns_weird.name: Minosaur

special_rules.exception: not if hit by ranged attacks prior to melee
special_rules.description: Its L increases by 1 on its first turn. This does NOT apply if it was hit by ranged attacks prior to melee.
Any PC rolling a 1 on a Defense roll is knocked down and must use 1 turn to get back up.

caverns_weird.notes: HCL+4 WM, HCL+4 Life, 3 attacks. Armed with a two-handed weapon. Its L increases by 1 on its first turn (not if hit by ranged attacks prior to melee). Any PC rolling a 1 on a Defense roll is knocked down and must use 1 turn to get back up.

caverns_weird.name: Cornucopia of Chaos

special_rules.attack_restriction: Cannot attack the Cornucopia while gremlins are in play; spells may still target it.
special_rules.on_destroy: All surviving gremlins turn into lumps of coal worth 1gp each.
special_rules.description: Generates d6 Azure Gremlins (L2 Vermin, never test Morale, no Treasure) per turn. When encountered, guarded by d6+1 gremlins. Cannot be attacked while gremlins are in play, but can be hit with spells. If destroyed, surviving gremlins become lumps of coal worth 1gp each.

reactions.result: The cornucopia of chaos fights to the death!

caverns_weird.notes: HCL+6 Chaos Artificial WM, Tier+2 Life, no attacks. Never tests Morale. Treasure: 2 rolls. Immune to Sleep and poison. Generates d6 Azure Gremlins (L2 Vermin, never test Morale, no Treasure) per turn. When encountered, guarded by d6+1 gremlins. Cannot be attacked while gremlins are in play (spells can still hit it). If destroyed, surviving gremlins turn into lumps of coal worth 1gp each.

caverns_weird.name: Cave Dragon

encounter_start_effects.description: Begins combat by spitting tar. All PCs must roll Defense vs. HCL+3 or be covered in tar. PCs rolling a 1 get tar in their eyes and have -1 to all Attack, Defense and Saves until they spend 1 turn to wipe their face. A Water Jet spell removes tar from a PC.

combat_effects.description: On other turns, the cave dragon performs 2 claw attacks (1 damage each) and breathes fire. All must Save vs. HCL+3 Fire or lose 1 Life. All Save at +L. PCs covered in tar add no bonus. Halflings re-roll a failed Save.

reactions.result: The cave dragon offers a Quest.
The cave dragon demands a 50gp gem.

caverns_weird.notes: HCL+5 Dragon WM, HCL+4 Life, 2 attacks. Morale -1. Treasure: 3 rolls. Begins combat by spitting tar: all PCs roll Defense vs. HCL+3 or be covered in tar; PCs rolling a 1 get tar in eyes (-1 to all Attack, Defense and Saves until 1 turn spent to wipe). On other turns, 2 claw attacks (1 damage each) and breathes fire (Save vs. HCL+3 Fire or lose 1 Life; all +L; tar-covered add no bonus; halflings reroll failed Save). A Water Jet spell removes tar from a PC.

caverns_boss.name: Manataur

special_rules.description: Every spell/prayer cast in its presence, including those from scrolls or items, adds +1 to its Life.

reactions.result: The manataur demands 2 scrolls or potions.

caverns_boss.notes: HCL+4 Chaos Boss, HCL+3 Life, 3 attacks. Treasure +1. Armed with a two-handed axe. Every spell/prayer cast in its presence, including those from scrolls or items, adds +1 to its Life.

caverns_boss.name: Caveman Champion

reactions.result: The caveman champion demands a Challenge of Champions.
The caveman champion demands a 50gp gem or a two-handed weapon.

caverns_boss.notes: HCL+4 Boss, HCL+3 Life, 4 attacks. Morale +1. Armed with two-handed club.

caverns_boss.name: Hoary Ogre of the Caverns

encounter_start_effects.description: At the beginning of the encounter, it utters a battle cry. All PCs must Save vs. L4 Fear or lose the ability to explode Attack rolls until the end of the encounter. Paladins are immune to this effect.

combat_modifiers.description: Halflings add +L to Defense rolls vs. ogres.

reactions.result: The hoary ogre of the caverns always fights!

caverns_boss.notes: HCL+4 Boss, HCL+3 Life, 4 attacks. Treasure +1. At the beginning of the encounter, it utters a battle cry. All PCs must Save vs. L4 Fear or lose the ability to explode Attack rolls until the end of the encounter. Paladins are immune. Halflings add +L to Defense rolls vs. ogres.

caverns_boss.name: Cavern Werebear

regeneration.description: This were-creature regenerates 1 Life every 3 turns (on the 3rd, 6th, 9th, etc.).

vulnerabilities.description: Silver weapons hit it with a +Tier bonus.

reactions.result: The cavern werebear fights to the death!

caverns_boss.notes: HCL+3 Were Boss, HCL+4 Life. Morale +1. Regenerates 1 Life every 3 turns (on the 3rd, 6th, 9th, etc.). Silver weapons hit it with a +Tier bonus. Its bite is not contagious.

caverns_boss.name: Land Siren
caverns_boss.attacks_note: Gains 1 additional Attack for every PC who falls asleep.

encounter_start_effects.description: At the start of combat, all living PCs must Save vs. HCL+2 magic or fall asleep. All PCs add +1/2 L to this Save. Halflings reroll a failed Save. The Siren gains 1 Attack for every PC who falls asleep.

special_rules.description: Sleeping PCs are automatically hit if attacked (they have no Defense roll). PCs remaining awake can use 1 turn to wake a sleeping companion. Revived PCs fight at -1 to Attack rolls until the end of the encounter.
Her glands can be sold to alchemists for d6x5gp.

reactions.result: The land siren offers a Quest.

caverns_boss.notes: HCL+5 Boss, HCL Life (minimum 3), 1 attack base (gains 1 more per sleeping PC). Treasure: 2 rolls. At the start of combat, all living PCs must Save vs. HCL+2 magic or fall asleep; all add +1/2 L, halflings reroll a failed Save. The Siren gains 1 Attack for every PC who falls asleep. Sleeping PCs are automatically hit (no Defense roll). PCs can use 1 turn to wake a companion; revived PCs fight at -1 Attack until end of encounter. Her glands can be sold to alchemists for d6x5gp.

caverns_boss.name: Fire Bear

special_attacks.description: Begins combat by breathing fire on its first turn. All PCs must make a Defense roll vs. HCL+3 or lose 2 Life. It will breathe fire again after any turn in which a PC uses a fire-based attack. In other turns, it performs 2 claw attacks (1 damage each).

reactions.result: The fire bear always fights to the death!

caverns_boss.notes: HCL+2 Boss, HCL+4 Life, 2 attacks. Never rolls Morale. Treasure: 2 rolls. Six-legged bear. Begins combat by breathing fire on its first turn: all PCs make a Defense roll vs. HCL+3 or lose 2 Life. Breathes fire again after any turn a PC uses a fire-based attack. In other turns, performs 2 claw attacks (1 damage each).

fungal_grottoes_vermin.name: Spore Mites

on_hit_effects.description: PCs hit must Save vs. L2 poison or suffer coughing fits: -1 to Attack rolls, non-cumulative, until the end of the encounter.

fungal_grottoes_vermin.notes: HCL Animal Vermin (max. L3). No Treasure. PCs hit must Save vs. L2 poison or suffer coughing fits: -1 to Attack rolls, non-cumulative, until the end of the encounter.

fungal_grottoes_vermin.name: Glowmaggots

special_rules.description: Their glow illuminates the grotto and no lantern/torch is needed in the tile they occupy.
Each maggot eaten by a PC counts as 1 Food ration but requires a Save vs. L1 poison (lose 1 Life on a failure).
Slain maggots may be used as a light source for 30 minutes/3 rooms, after which their glow fades.

fungal_grottoes_vermin.notes: HCL Vermin (max. L2). No Treasure. Their glow illuminates the grotto (no lantern/torch needed in their tile). Each maggot eaten counts as 1 Food ration but requires a Save vs. L1 poison (fail = lose 1 Life). Slain maggots can be used as a light source for 30 minutes/3 rooms.

fungal_grottoes_vermin.name: Fungus Leeches

on_hit_effects.description: PCs hit must Save vs. L4 poison or lose 1 additional Life. Halflings and barbarians Save at +L.

special_rules.description: A bag of salt thrown at them (2gp in town) will automatically kill 2 leeches.

fungal_grottoes_vermin.notes: HCL+1 Animal Vermin (max. L4). No Treasure. Immune to poison. PCs hit must Save vs. L4 poison or lose 1 additional Life. Halflings and barbarians Save at +L. A bag of salt (2gp) will automatically kill 2 leeches.

fungal_grottoes_vermin.name: Myco-Gnats

combat_modifiers.description: They distract PCs, giving -1 to all spellcasting rolls and ranged attacks.

special_rules.description: A Fireball spell will kill all the myco-gnats.

fungal_grottoes_vermin.notes: HCL Vermin (max. L4). No Treasure. They distract PCs, giving -1 to all spellcasting rolls and ranged attacks. A Fireball spell will kill all the myco-gnats.

fungal_grottoes_vermin.name: Spore Toads

per_turn_effects.description: Each turn, roll a 1-in-6 chance that one belches a puff of hallucinogenic spores, causing all PCs to Save vs. L2 magic or be at -1 Defense until the end of the encounter.

fungal_grottoes_vermin.notes: HCL+2 Vermin (max. L4). Treasure -1. Each turn, roll a 1-in-6 chance that one belches hallucinogenic spores: all PCs Save vs. L2 magic or be at -1 Defense until the end of the encounter.

fungal_grottoes_vermin.name: Boneworms

special_rules.description: Any PC slain by them cannot be resurrected.
If a vial of holy water is thrown at them, they take no damage but must roll Morale.

fungal_grottoes_vermin.notes: HCL+2 Vermin (max. L5). Treasure: 1 roll. These pale worms crunch bone when feeding. Any PC slain by them cannot be resurrected. Not undead but connected with necromantic energies. If a vial of holy water is thrown at them, they take no damage but must roll Morale.

fungal_grottoes_minions.name: Spore Men

on_hit_effects.description: Living PCs hit must Save vs. L3 poison or lose 1 Life. Mushroom PCs are immune. Halflings reroll failed Saves.

fungal_grottoes_minions.notes: HCL+2 Minions (max. L8). Immune to poison. Treasure -1. Living PCs hit must Save vs. L3 poison or lose 1 Life. Mushroom PCs are immune. Halflings reroll failed Saves.

fungal_grottoes_minions.name: Halfling Mushroom Pickers

trade_reaction.goods: d6 random rare mushrooms and 2d6 Food rations
trade_reaction.description: On a Trade reaction, they offer d6 random rare mushrooms and 2d6 Food rations for sale at standard prices, -10% if the party includes any halflings.

reactions.result: The halfling mushroom pickers offer food and rest.
The halfling mushroom pickers offer to trade.

fungal_grottoes_minions.notes: HCL+1 Minions (max. L5). Armed with knives and slings. Treasure: Their goods. On a Trade reaction, they offer d6 random rare mushrooms and 2d6 Food rations at standard prices (-10% if the party includes halflings).

fungal_grottoes_minions.name: Moldspawn

on_hit_effects.description: PCs hit must Save vs. L2 disease or lose 1 additional Life at the end of the encounter (1 Life per encounter, not 1 Life per hit).

reactions.result: The moldspawn demand 1 Food ration each.

fungal_grottoes_minions.notes: HCL+3 Minions. No Treasure. Dripping, half-decayed humanoids coated in green mold. Immune to poison. PCs hit must Save vs. L2 disease or lose 1 additional Life at the end of the encounter (1 Life per encounter, not 1 Life per hit).

fungal_grottoes_minions.name: Myceliarchs

encounter_start_effects.description: At the start of combat, one will cast a sleep-spore cloud: all PCs must Save vs. L3 magic or miss their next turn.

reactions.result: The myceliarchs demand a Blood Offering.

fungal_grottoes_minions.notes: HCL+3 Minions. Morale +1. Treasure +1. Fungus priests of He Who Lies Below. Immune to poison. At the start of combat, one casts a sleep-spore cloud: all PCs must Save vs. L3 magic or miss their next turn.

fungal_grottoes_minions.name: Cave Locusts

combat_modifiers.description: PCs wearing any armor double its Defense bonus (light armor +2, heavy armor +4).

post_combat_effects.description: Locusts consume food: if the party carries any Food rations, the party loses d6 Food rations at the end of combat. Distribute the loss as desired among PCs.

reactions.result: The cave locusts ignore the party.

fungal_grottoes_minions.notes: HCL Minions (max. L5). Swarming, biting insects. PCs wearing armor double its Defense bonus (light +2, heavy +4). At the end of combat, if the party carries Food rations, they lose d6 Food rations. Distribute the loss among PCs as desired.

fungal_grottoes_minions.name: Toadstool Knights

special_rules.description: These fungus warriors wield shield-like caps made of dried fungi. The first hit against each toadstool knight breaks its shield but the toadstool knight survives. Casting a Warp Wood spell will destroy all wooden caps.

reactions.result: The toadstool knights ignore the party.

fungal_grottoes_minions.notes: HCL+4 Minions. Immune to poison. Morale +1. Standard Treasure. These fungus warriors wield shield-like caps of dried fungi. The first hit breaks the shield but the knight survives. Casting Warp Wood destroys all caps.
